====Sinister Offering====
Casting [[Sinister Offering]] requires level 92 [[Magic]], one [[blood rune]], and one [[wrath rune]]. Players must have level 70 Prayer in order to offer superior dragon bones via the spell.
{{#vardefine:CastPerHour|600}}
